summary: Check end-to-end user states, error recovery, accessibility, and stale-client behavior.
questions: What does the user see before, during, after, and on failure?
Can the flow recover after refresh, resume, reconnect, or lost events?
reject_when: the client assumes an event was never lost
a stale local state cannot be reconciled with the source of truth
escalate_when: material evidence identifies a failure outside this Lens concern
an affected artifact or boundary has no selected Lens owner
